info.title: FullParty Integration API
info.description:
# Build for your community
Read characters, discover runs, submit applications and keep members informed through an approved FullParty integration.

## Authentication
Send `Authorization: Bearer <integration-api-token>` on every API request. An administrator grants scopes to each integration. Tokens are server credentials: keep them in your backend, never ship them in a browser or game plugin.

The **member API** also requires `X-FullParty-Discord-User-Id`. Your trusted client must authenticate the Discord user before supplying this header. FullParty resolves an active connection, checks the account is verified and not banned, then applies the member's permissions. Never accept this identifier unverified from an end user. `members:read` and `members:write` are independent opt-in scopes; bot clients do not gain them automatically.

## API paths
All integration endpoints are versioned under `/api/integrations/v1`. Bot operations use `/api/integrations/v1/bot` with the existing integration token and scopes; no linked-member header is required. Member operations use `/api/integrations/v1` and require the linked-member header and member scopes described above.

To migrate an existing bot, change its API base path from `/api/integrations` to `/api/integrations/v1/bot` and keep every endpoint suffix, method, body, and response parser unchanged. The unversioned endpoints have been removed, with no redirects or compatibility aliases. Coordinate the bot update with the website deployment. Website-to-bot webhooks are unchanged.

## Supported actions
Account and profile preferences, Lodestone claims and verification, group membership and availability, run discovery, saved runs, applications, notifications, reports and published resources are available. Moderator workflows, roster changes, passwords, account deletion and login-provider connections remain website-only. The separate XIVPlugin OAuth API is not part of this trusted-client contract.

## Requests and errors
Use JSON except for image uploads (multipart/form-data). Discord snowflakes are **strings**. Timestamps use ISO 8601. Member requests accept `Accept-Language: en`, `de`, `fr` or `ja` (English by default).
- 401: invalid or inactive integration credential.
- 403: missing scope, banned account or forbidden action.
- 404: record missing or inaccessible.
- 422: validation failed; inspect `errors` for field messages.
- 429: rate limited; respect `Retry-After`.

## Limits and retries
Requests are limited to 360/minute/source IP before authentication and 180/minute/authenticated client. Avatar uploads and profile image uploads are additionally limited to 5/minute and 30/day per linked member, shared across integration clients; profile changes without an uploaded image do not consume the upload limit. External lookups, membership writes, reports and application submissions also use normal per-user limits. Cache read results where appropriate and use exponential backoff for transient failures. Personal API responses use private, no-store caching headers.

There is no generic Idempotency-Key contract. Do not blindly retry mutations: verify the result first. Application submission returns an existing non-withdrawn application, and saving/following is idempotent.

## Pagination
Most member lists accept `page` (starting at 1) and `per_page` (1–100, default 25). Run discovery returns 10, notifications 50 and resources 50 per page. Bot endpoint limits are documented individually.

## Webhook verification
FullParty sends POST requests to your configured webhook URL. Webhook and healthcheck destinations require HTTPS outside local development and tests. Redirects are not followed: configure the final destination URL so signed payloads and credentials cannot be forwarded to another host. Verify the `sha256=` prefixed HMAC-SHA256 of `timestamp + '.' + rawRequestBody` using your webhook signing secret, compare in constant time, reject stale timestamps, and deduplicate delivery IDs. Headers are `X-FullParty-Event`, `X-FullParty-Delivery`, `X-FullParty-Timestamp`, and `X-FullParty-Signature`. API tokens and signing secrets are separate credentials.

Starting-soon and starting-now capabilities both deliver **discord.guild.run_reminder**, distinguished by `reminder_type`. Guild disconnection uses the guild-settings capability. A separate signed GET healthcheck runs every 15 minutes; its signature uses an empty body (`timestamp + '.'`). Return JSON `status: "healthy"`, `"degraded"` or `"unhealthy"`.
